title: CONFLICT
author: Parashuram Rao Gande
text:
The papaya tree in a backyard of a
House amidst so many houses
Is overloaded with fruit ripe
And alluring and mouth watering
A monkey`s eyes fell on the green tree
The monkey in a moment
Signalled to the other monkey`s in a herd
Which are in search of food
The monkey which first arrived
Jumped on the tree and started
Eating the golden fruit
The inmates of the house
Started attacking the monkey with sticks
They have been waiting the fruit to ripe
For so many days eagerly
But alas! See what happens in moment
If the monkeys had found  fruit
In the the forest surrounding.
If the monkeys found trees
On the surrounding hills with sufficient
Trees with fruit to eat
If the the monkeys found streams
Flowing with water to drink from
The monkeys would not have ventured
Into human habitations.
Just because of human intervention
In to their territory by destroying trees
And hills,and destroying streams
The animals venture in to
Human habitations in villages and towns.
